name: Temple City Animal Hospital
description: Temple City Animal Hospital provides veterinary care for dogs in Temple City, CA. Confirm hours and services directly with the clinic.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: I've been taking my canines here since I was a boy playing soccer/baseball with one of the former vet's sons. Some 35+ years later and I won't take my dogs anywhere else. They're the best all-around: vets, techs, office staff. All are tops!
